name: Careful Aim
text: Add 1 to the Shoot characteristic of this fighter for its next Ranged Attack action this activation.

name: Diving Charge
text: A fighter can use this ability after making a move action where it fell more than 2" vertically. Until the end of their activation, you may add 1 to their Fight characteristic for every full 2" they fell.

name: Respite
text: A fighter cannot use this ability while within 1" of an enemy fighter. Remove (X) damage points from this fighter.

name: Rush
text: Add 1 to the Move characteristic of this fighter until the end of their activation.

name: Inspiring Presence
text: Select a visible friendly fighter within 6" of this fighter that has not activated yet this battle round. You can activate that fighter immediately after this fighter's activation ends.

name: Onslaught
text: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee attack actions made by this fighter until the end of their activation.

name: Rampage
text: This fighter makes a bonus move action. Then, they can make a bonus attack action.

name: Counter
text: Use this reaction when targeted by a melee attack action but before the hit rolls are made. If one or more hit rolls from that attack action misses, inflict 2 damage points to the attacking fighter. If any hit rolls from that attack action is a 1, inflict 3 damage to the attacking fighter instead.

name: Hunker Down
text: A fighter that is in cover can make this reaction after they are targeted by a ranged attack action but before the hit rolls are made. For that attack action, increase this fighter's Defense characteristic by 2 (on top of their cover bonus).

name: Strike them down
text: A fighter can make this reaction when a visible enemy fighter within 1" of them makes a disengage action but before that fighter moves away. Roll a dice. On a 4+, allocate D6 damage points to that enemy fighter.
